question: In a certain code language, ‘HUSBAND’ is written as ‘DNABSUH’ and ‘CLEARLY’ is written as ‘YLRAELC’. How will ‘HARBOUR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HUSBAND’ is written as ‘DNABSUH',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d61c046ef21fa8674c5b50426f3908f70347038cebb1a0c19f61e08b286d114.png] 

‘CLEARLY’ is written as ‘YLRAELC’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c9e4d3c42956db99109b7fd2b604389b290651bba3ac155301b1bcd283eacf.png] 

Similarly, for 'HARBOUR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f1769633fca76571168a2023cffe4fd6156f59a4b886659f816e92abc0c3fe3.png] 

So, 'HARBOUR' is written as 'RUOBRAH'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
